explication: ClearDisk is a macOS menu-bar disk monitor and developer-cache cleaner. The main path is launch, check Full Disk Access, scan known caches and project artifacts, review risk and reclaimable space, then move selected items to Trash; a separate disk-space workspace scans locations and visualizes their contents. The README also documents alerts, forecasts, suggestions, cleanup tracking, and signed updates. Several subsystems are represented from README claims because their implementation paths were not excerpted; their internal links are omitted where ownership is not evidenced.
